import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter, MaxNLocator

SOURCE = Path('/app/benchmark/source_data.json')
OUT = Path('/app/output/result.png')
OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

with SOURCE.open() as f:
    raw = json.load(f)

payments = pd.DataFrame(raw['digital_payment_penetration']['data'])
branches = pd.DataFrame(raw['traditional_bank_branches']['data'])
users = pd.DataFrame(raw['neobank_users']['data'])
licenses = pd.DataFrame(raw['digital_bank_licenses']['data'])

regions = ['North America', 'Europe', 'Asia-Pacific', 'Latin America']
region_colors = {
    'North America': '#1f5a9e',
    'Europe': '#6a4c93',
    'Asia-Pacific': '#0b7a75',
    'Latin America': '#c56a22',
}
blue = '#1F77B4'
teal = '#00A6A6'
orange = '#D97904'
red = '#B63A3A'
grey = '#5A6470'
dark = '#17202A'
light_grid = '#D9DEE7'
bg = '#FFFFFF'

# Global / regional derived series, using source fields only.
pay_global = payments.groupby('year', as_index=False)['penetration_pct'].mean()
branch_global = branches.groupby('year', as_index=False)['branches_k'].sum()
license_global = licenses.groupby('year', as_index=False)['cumulative_licenses'].sum()
user_global = users.groupby('year', as_index=False)['users_m'].sum()

branch_global['retention_pct_2015'] = branch_global['branches_k'] / branch_global.loc[branch_global['year'].eq(2015), 'branches_k'].iloc[0] * 100
license_global['annual_approvals'] = license_global['cumulative_licenses'].diff().fillna(license_global['cumulative_licenses']).astype(int)
branch_global['annual_closures_k'] = -branch_global['branches_k'].diff()
branch_global.loc[branch_global['year'].eq(2015), 'annual_closures_k'] = np.nan

# Regional disruption positioning, 2024 vs 2015/2016 baselines.
pay_2024 = payments[payments.year == 2024].set_index('region')['penetration_pct']
pay_2015 = payments[payments.year == 2015].set_index('region')['penetration_pct']
br_2024 = branches[branches.year == 2024].set_index('region')['branches_k']
br_2015 = branches[branches.year == 2015].set_index('region')['branches_k']
user_2024 = users[users.year == 2024].set_index('region')['users_m']
lic_2024 = licenses[licenses.year == 2024].set_index('region')['cumulative_licenses']
regional = pd.DataFrame({
    'penetration_2024': pay_2024,
    'penetration_gain_pp': pay_2024 - pay_2015,
    'branch_decline_pct': (br_2015 - br_2024) / br_2015 * 100,
    'neobank_users_2024': user_2024,
    'licenses_2024': lic_2024,
}).loc[regions]

# Annual license approvals by region from cumulative counts.
lic_pivot = licenses.pivot(index='year', columns='region', values='cumulative_licenses').loc[:, regions]
annual_lic = lic_pivot.diff().fillna(lic_pivot).astype(int)
annual_lic = annual_lic.loc[2016:2024]

# Figure layout.
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 14,
    'axes.labelsize': 10.5,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 9.5,
    'axes.edgecolor': '#B8C1CC',
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
})
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 11), dpi=180, facecolor=bg)
gs = GridSpec(2, 3, figure=fig, width_ratios=[1.35, 1, 1], height_ratios=[1.12, 1], wspace=0.28, hspace=0.34)
ax_main = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
ax_closures = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax_users = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_heat = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax_region = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])

fig.suptitle('Fintech Disruption Is Rewiring Banking: Digital Adoption Rises as Branch Networks Contract',
             x=0.03, y=0.975, ha='left', va='top', fontsize=21, fontweight='bold', color=dark)
fig.text(0.03, 0.944,
         'Global composites across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America · 2015–2024',
         ha='left', va='top', fontsize=11.5, color=grey)

# Main crossover panel.
years = pay_global['year'].values
ax_main.plot(years, pay_global['penetration_pct'], color=teal, lw=3.4, marker='o', ms=5.5,
             label='Digital payment penetration (% of adults, regional avg.)')
ax_main.plot(branch_global['year'], branch_global['retention_pct_2015'], color=red, lw=3.2, marker='s', ms=5,
             label='Traditional branch network (% of 2015 locations)')
ax_main.set_title('1  Digital penetration overtakes physical branch footprint', loc='left', pad=12, fontweight='bold', color=dark)
ax_main.set_ylabel('Percent (%)')
ax_main.set_xlabel('Year')
ax_main.set_xlim(2014.7, 2024.3)
ax_main.set_ylim(35, 106)
ax_main.set_xticks(range(2015, 2025))
ax_main.grid(axis='y', color=light_grid, lw=0.8)
ax_main.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)

# Find approximate crossover between two lines.
x = pay_global['year'].values.astype(float)
y1 = pay_global['penetration_pct'].values
y2 = branch_global['retention_pct_2015'].values
cross_x, cross_y = None, None
for i in range(len(x)-1):
    d1, d2 = y1[i]-y2[i], y1[i+1]-y2[i+1]
    if d1 == 0 or d1*d2 <= 0:
        t = abs(d1)/(abs(d1)+abs(d2)) if (abs(d1)+abs(d2)) else 0
        cross_x = x[i] + t*(x[i+1]-x[i])
        cross_y = y1[i] + t*(y1[i+1]-y1[i])
        break
if cross_x is not None:
    ax_main.scatter([cross_x], [cross_y], s=95, color=dark, zorder=6)
    ax_main.axvline(cross_x, color=dark, lw=1.1, ls='--', alpha=0.55)
    ax_main.annotate(f'Crossover\n~{cross_x:.1f}', xy=(cross_x, cross_y), xytext=(cross_x+0.35, cross_y+12),
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=dark, lw=1.1), fontsize=10.5, color=dark,
                     bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', fc='white', ec='#CCD3DD', alpha=0.95))

ax_main.annotate(f'{pay_global.iloc[-1].penetration_pct:.1f}%\ndigital penetration',
                 xy=(2024, pay_global.iloc[-1].penetration_pct), xytext=(2021.1, 91.5),
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=teal, lw=1.1), color=teal, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax_main.annotate(f'{branch_global.iloc[-1].retention_pct_2015:.1f}%\nof 2015 branches\nremain',
                 xy=(2024, branch_global.iloc[-1].retention_pct_2015), xytext=(2020.5, 53.5),
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=red, lw=1.1), color=red, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

ax_main2 = ax_main.twinx()
ax_main2.plot(license_global['year'], license_global['cumulative_licenses'], color=orange, lw=2.8, marker='^', ms=5,
              label='Digital banking licenses (cumulative count)')
ax_main2.set_ylim(0, max(license_global['cumulative_licenses']) * 1.16)
ax_main2.set_ylabel('Digital bank licenses (count)')
ax_main2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_main2.spines['right'].set_color('#B8C1CC')
ax_main2.tick_params(axis='y', colors=orange)
ax_main2.yaxis.label.set_color(orange)
ax_main2.annotate(f'{int(license_global.iloc[-1].cumulative_licenses)} licenses',
                  xy=(2024, license_global.iloc[-1].cumulative_licenses), xytext=(2020.9, 235),
                  arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=orange, lw=1.1), color=orange, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

handles1, labels1 = ax_main.get_legend_handles_labels()
handles2, labels2 = ax_main2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax_main.legend(handles1 + handles2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.01, 0.99),
               frameon=True, framealpha=0.96, facecolor='white', edgecolor='#CDD5DF')

# Branch closures acceleration panel.
closures = branch_global.dropna(subset=['annual_closures_k']).copy()
bar_colors = [red if y >= 2020 else '#AEB7C4' for y in closures['year']]
ax_closures.bar(closures['year'], closures['annual_closures_k'], color=bar_colors, width=0.72)
ax_closures.set_title('2  Branch closures accelerate after 2019', loc='left', pad=12, fontweight='bold', color=dark)
ax_closures.set_ylabel('Branches closed YoY (thousand)')
ax_closures.set_xlabel('Year')
ax_closures.set_xticks(range(2016, 2025, 2))
ax_closures.yaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(5))
ax_closures.grid(axis='y', color=light_grid, lw=0.8)
ax_closures.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
pre = closures[closures.year <= 2019]['annual_closures_k'].mean()
post = closures[closures.year >= 2020]['annual_closures_k'].mean()
ax_closures.axhline(pre, color='#7F8894', ls='--', lw=1.1)
ax_closures.axhline(post, color=red, ls='--', lw=1.2)
ax_closures.text(2016.0, pre + 0.7, f'2016–19 avg: {pre:.1f}k', color='#6B7480', fontsize=9.5)
ax_closures.text(2020.1, post + 0.8, f'2020–24 avg: {post:.1f}k', color=red, fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold')
peak = closures.loc[closures['annual_closures_k'].idxmax()]
ax_closures.annotate(f'{peak.annual_closures_k:.1f}k', xy=(peak.year, peak.annual_closures_k), xytext=(peak.year-1.2, peak.annual_closures_k+2.8),
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=dark, lw=1), color=dark, fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold')

user_pivot = users.pivot(index='year', columns='region', values='users_m').loc[:, regions]

                   colors=[region_colors[r] for r in regions], alpha=0.88, labels=regions)

ax_users.set_ylabel('Registered neobank users (million)')
ax_users.set_xlabel('Year')
ax_users.set_xlim(2016, 2024)
ax_users.set_xticks(range(2016, 2025, 2))
ax_users.grid(axis='y', color=light_grid, lw=0.8)
ax_users.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
ax_users.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, ncol=1, facecolor='white', edgecolor='#CDD5DF', framealpha=0.94)
ax_users.annotate(f'{user_global.iloc[-1].users_m:.1f}M total\nin 2024', xy=(2024, user_global.iloc[-1].users_m),
